title: Feedback Record
description: The single wire contract for a loopback record (design §5). De-identified by construction: no raw artifact/output content is carried, only the synthesized lesson (summary) plus a minimal redacted excerpt. The record carries NO id — the server assigns the canonical id ('fb_<uuid>') on ingest and returns it. Reused by the client core (ajv) and the central FastAPI service (pydantic).

artifact.description: The skill/agent/artifact the feedback is about; closes the attribution gap.

kind.description: The kind of artifact the feedback is about.

version.description: Artifact version from the plugin manifest / marketplace pin, e.g. '3.2.0'.

repo.description: Optional repo where the user was working (e.g. from 'git remote get-url origin'), e.g. 'github.com/org/prd-writer'.

summary.description: The synthesized lesson = the feedback summary: a generalizable, de-identified statement of what went wrong and what 'correct' looks like.

evidenceExcerpt.description: Minimal, redacted excerpt — exactly what the user saw in the consent gate. No raw artifact stored.

timestamp.description: When the feedback was generated (RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 date-time).

confidence.description: Detector self-rating of its own judgment.

clusterKey.description: Client's proposed dedup key (§8), e.g. 'prd-writer:prd-authoring:wrong-template'. The server may recompute.

harness.description: Which agent harness produced the feedback. Optional: omitted when unknown rather than mislabeled.
